context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the project-manager instructions from the published agnostic-planning-skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Do not generate a status report without current data — ask for updates if stale. In non-interactive contexts, mark unknowns as "needs update" and proceed.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Assign estimates with confidence levels; flag tasks needing further breakdown or spikes.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **HARD GATE — Estimation Review:**

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: The estimation must be reviewed before proceeding to risk assessment.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Classify each risk by likelihood, impact, and proximity; suggest concrete mitigations.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Identify the top 3 critical risks.

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: The risk register must be reviewed before tracking setup.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Every High/High risk must have a named owner and a mitigation plan.

checklist.name: instruction-9
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Define tracking checkpoints:

checklist.name: instruction-10
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Check-in cadence:** Daily standup, weekly sync, or async updates.
